content: Russia 2025 НДФЛ progressive scale: 13% up to 2.4M RUB/yr; 15% (312,000 + 15% over 2.4M) for 2.4-5M; 18% (702,000 + 18% over 5M) for 5-20M; 20% (3,402,000 + 20% over 20M) for 20-50M; 22% (9,402,000 + 22% over 50M) above 50M. Marginal/cumulative narastayushchim itogom within calendar year per tax agent (employer), resets Jan 1. Since 2023 (263-FZ), withholding happens at each payment (including advance) based on actual payment date, not last day of month.
